title: Unreferenced files: a verdict for each of the 126, and a tick-list of the dead ones for you

chat.text: The census found 126 files nothing references. Haiku minions give each a verdict with evidence (dead, loaded at runtime, a record worth keeping, or misplaced with its proper home); Sonnet spot-checks fifteen. You get a tick-list of the dead ones by module with bytes, and a scripted mover with an undo that is ready but not run. Nothing is deleted.
